description: We’re ε″, a student team from Uzbekistan tackling soil salinization: salt ruins farmland before it’s visible. We’ll build an interactive web app that maps surface changes in irrigated fields with NISAR radar data, plus our own physics layer explaining why salt and moisture look alike at L-band. We bring radar physics modeling, Python and ML, data analysis and CubeSat experience. Looking for: web/front-end dev, SAR/GIS data processing, UI/UX design and pitch storytelling.
